If a critical application went down tomorrow, what would your team restore first?

The answer should come from a conversation with the people who rely on it. Finance, operations, and customer support may have different priorities. An application may also depend on another service that needs to be available first.

A useful planning exercise is to choose one business process and walk through an outage together. Identify the information, systems, people, and approvals needed to get that process working again.

Record assumptions as questions to verify in a planned recovery exercise. Keep the scope manageable and capture what you learn.

When was the last time your business owners and technical team compared their expectations for recovery?

#BusinessContinuity #ITOperations
